caption: The drawing depicts a giraffe standing in the center, with its body oriented to the left and its head turned slightly to the right. The giraffe is light in color, with brownish patches, and is being held by a leash or rope by a human figure to the right. There are three human figures in total, all dressed in long, light-colored garments with some decorations or patterns. One figure is holding the giraffe's leash while the other two stand nearby, with one of them apparently holding a bowl. Surrounding the figures and giraffe are trees; a reddish-brown tree with dark-green leaves on the left and two palm-like trees on the right with long, dark green fronds. The entire scene is enclosed within an irregular, almost rounded rectangular border decorated with a pattern of alternating dark circles and light floral shapes, mostly pink and white. The background inside the border is filled with a mottled or textured blue color, while the area outside the drawing is plain beige. The figures, giraffe, and trees are rendered with muted earth tones, primarily using blues, pinks, browns, and greens. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
